text: Entry Requirements The applicant must be a non-Chinese citizen from18 to 25 years old with a valid foreign passport. You shall be healthy, have a good character and conduct, strictly follow the laws of Chinese government as well as regulations and rules of the university. You shall respect the customs and habits of Chinese people and have the diploma of high school (or the diploma equal to high school) at least. In addition, you are required to reach HSK Level 4 or above. Notes: International students who apply for the bachelor's degree in Capital University of Physical Education and Sports (CUPES) but fail to reach the required HSK level can study Chinese for one year in the university as a preparatory student. You will become an undergraduate after obtaining a qualified result in HSK test.
